groups.name: Import is inert and authorization URL has verified endpoints/audience/explicit scopes
Missing or guessed wildcard/demand scopes and insecure callback fail before HTTP
Code exchange uses actual OAuth library and one form-encoded client-secret-post request
State mismatch and missing authentication method fail before token HTTP
Client-secret-basic authentication and refresh token rotation use actual library
Missing rotating refresh receipt and non-Bearer token remain unknown
Rotating refresh transport loss and invalid-grant never retry or leak provider error text
Businesses endpoint projects documented data and never implies list completeness
Provider IDs, bearer whitespace and missing credentials fail before HTTP
Negotiation projection retains business/customer/job context and rejects cross-ID receipts
Business negotiation list refuses cross-business records
Message history retains exact long text and marks unsupported attachment structure
Native reply POST is exactly text-only and requires matching provider message receipt
Empty, control-containing and over-bound replies fail before HTTP
A 2xx without matching native receipt stays unknown without repeat
Native transport errors, server errors, conflict and malformed JSON stay unknown
Explicit authorization/rate-limit rejections never trigger automatic sends
Redirect response and declared/streamed overflow are refused without follow or retry
Wrong media type, primitive JSON and excess rows fail closed
Business webhook creation is disabled and includes verified event names and Basic credentials
Webhook callbacks reject foreign hosts, credentials, fragments, duplicate and missing query bindings
Created webhook mismatches and missing receipt stay unknown
Webhook listing retains unrelated events without authorizing them or leaking auth credentials
Enable and disable use only PUT enabled boolean and retain explicit receipt identity
Slow response body is bounded by the same five-second deadline and never repeats POST

limits: Actual Thumbtack account/permission/provider behavior is not tested.
Provisioned scopes and token authentication method remain explicit prerequisites.
Native POST success requires a matching message receipt; absent receipt stays unknown.
Indexed primary docs are protocol evidence, not an observed provider response.
